summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim unaudited consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 and an operating and financial review. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, comparable to a quarterly earnings release. No M&A, activist, restructuring, tender offer, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The document only contains standard financial disclosures and incorporates by reference into existing registration statements.
